summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Jake McCabe, an American professional ice hockey defenseman. It states his birth date, his current team, the Buffalo Sabres of the National Hockey League, and how the Sabres drafted him.
one_line: Jake McCabe is an American ice hockey defenseman who plays for the Buffalo Sabres of the NHL.
key_facts: Jake McCabe was born on October 12, 1993.
Jake McCabe is an American professional ice hockey defenseman.
Jake McCabe currently plays for the Buffalo Sabres of the National Hockey League (NHL).
The Buffalo Sabres drafted Jake McCabe in the 2nd round of the 2012 NHL Entry Draft.
Jake McCabe was selected 44th overall in the 2012 NHL Entry Draft.
Jake McCabe's draft position was 2nd round, 44th overall, in 2012.
